summary: Hand-written commands that print through printJSONOrTableWithMeta honor --csv and --plain before falling back to the JSON envelope for piped output; CSV and plain cells print numbers in full rather than in scientific notation.
reason: fts, filings list/get/exhibits, companies lookup/search, feed latest, status, sic show, facts statement and the transcendence commands always printed the {results, meta} JSON envelope when stdout was not a terminal, silently ignoring --csv and --plain; this print predates the generator's printPlain, so --plain did nothing anywhere.
validated_outcome: Piped `filings list --csv` and `--plain` print header plus rows, `facts statement --csv` prints 265595000000 instead of 2.65595e+11, and output without a format flag keeps the JSON envelope.
